attempts.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet for the existing Mass Effect 1 fan RPG Relay Chronicles. This is an EDIT/DERIVATION from supplied reference images, not a game screenshot or concept illustration. Output a native 1536 x 1024 landscape RGBA image with a truly TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly FOUR isolated full-body sprite drawings, arranged in 2 columns x 2 rows. Each pose must fit completely inside its own 768 x 512 cell with at least 48 pixels of empty transparent padding on all edges and around every extended weapon or limb. Clear empty gutters, no touching poses, no cropped heads/feet/fingers/weapon barrels. Orthographic three-quarter enemy view facing screen LEFT in all three upright states; prone body also head LEFT. Realistic adult body proportions, detailed pre-rendered HD game sprite materials, crisp readable silhouette, soft neutral upper-left lighting, no pixel art, no chibi. Do not copy text, borders, other characters, scenes or interface elements from either reference. Do not add text, labels, arrows, numbers, effects, smoke, magic rings, particles, ground planes or cast shadows outside the body. Keep body identity, anatomy, palette, armor and camera consistent across all four poses. Exactly one subject per cell. Do not include any other enemy from the reference atlas. SUBJECT: ONLY the ME1 HUSK / Zombie, the unarmed gaunt cybernetic humanoid in TOP ROW SECOND CELL of the supplied atlas. The second supplied image is the official Prima ME1 page 68 with the explicitly named Husk bust: use its bald desiccated gray-blue head, inset glowing blue eyes, sunken mouth, visible blue cybernetic lines and torso nodes as a partial identity reference. Preserve the first atlas full-body thin hunched humanoid silhouette and neutral gray-blue skin, exposed ribs/cybernetic conduits, elongated bare hands, thin legs and bare feet. Not a skeleton, not a muscular monster, not a rotting bloody zombie, not a spiked creature, not a geth robot. NO WEAPON, no armor suit, no clothes added, no gore, no detached parts. Blue nodes/eyes may be visibly luminous within the body but no aura or bloom beyond the silhouette. CELL ORDER: TOP LEFT aim = unarmed alert hunched stalking stance facing screen LEFT, both hands open and low ready for melee, no aiming weapon. TOP RIGHT power = unarmed striking/lunging MELEE key pose facing LEFT, one clawed hand extended and the other near chest, feet grounded in a short braced stance; depict the body gesture only, no electricity or effect. BOTTOM LEFT hit = unarmed recoil from a hit with torso bent back, knees bent and arms pulled inward, complete fingers and feet visible. BOTTOM RIGHT down = intact motionless humanoid lying on its side fully at ground level, bald head LEFT and feet RIGHT, arms folded close to the body, no injury gore. Keep the full prone figure inside its cell with generous margins. Maintain one consistent bald head, body mass, rib layout, blue implants and anatomy across the four poses. These are four discrete fixed key poses, not a movement strip.
attempts.result: Four complete fixed key poses; measured irregular frame rectangles, native transparency and low-alpha fringe retained.
